text: Meɗan faalaa neeminirgol ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, ɓen ɓe Fir'awna lo'innoo ka leydi Misra; halkugol gaño maɓɓe on, e ittugol lo'ineede e maɓɓe, e waɗugol ɓe yeesooɓe ñentinteeɓe ka Goonga, Men waɗa ɓe ronooɓe leydi Saami barkinaandi ndin ɓaawo halkugol Fir'awna, wano Toowuɗo On Daaliri non: ( Men ronini ɓen yimɓe laatinooɓe no lo'inee ka funnaange leydi e ka hirnaange mayri, ndin ndi Men barkini e muuɗum...).
